title: Black Benny's tricks and Sidney Montague
summary: Montague played straight; Black Benny threw sticks and held his bass drum in odd ways in parades.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Was there any other drummers around here that you saw that had any tricks like that?
I didn't see anyone that had any tricks. Sidney Montague, he was a wonderful little drummer, but he never did do any tricks on the drum. He just always would play straight.
What about Black Benny? Did Black Benny have no tricks?

Well, Benny had tricks. Benny had a lot of tricks. He would throw the sticks up in the air. He would hold the drums in different kinds of ways while he was playing. He would hold the bass drum on the side and play, and the people would notice him. He would do a whole lot of other things with his bass drum. He would play in the parade. Yeah, the parade. He would take the drum off the strap and hold it down and play. Yeah, hold it in his head.
Yeah, hold it in his head.
He was a wonderful guy. Benny was. Yeah, he was a wonderful guy.
